rules.description: Employee's EPF contribution rate, applied to (Basic + DA).
Employer's EPF contribution rate, applied to (Basic + DA), subject to the statutory wage ceiling unless the employer voluntarily contributes on full basic.
Statutory monthly wage ceiling up to which mandatory EPF/EPS contribution applies. Many employers contribute on full basic voluntarily, which this tool treats as an explicit opt-in.
Monthly gross wage threshold at or below which ESI coverage is mandatory.
Employee's ESI contribution rate on gross wages, when ESI-eligible.
Employer's ESI contribution rate on gross wages, when the employee is ESI-eligible.
Gratuity payable per completed year of service = (last drawn monthly Basic + DA) x 15/26. CTC breakups commonly provision this annually as an employer cost.
Lifetime income-tax exemption cap on gratuity received by employees covered under the Payment of Gratuity Act.
HRA exemption limb: 50% of (Basic + DA) for employees residing in Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata or Chennai.
HRA exemption limb: 40% of (Basic + DA) for employees residing outside the four metros.
HRA exemption limb: rent paid minus 10% of (Basic + DA).
Standard deduction available to salaried taxpayers under the old tax regime.
Standard deduction available to salaried taxpayers under the new tax regime.
rules.source: Income Tax Act, Section 16(ia), Finance Act 2024

rules.description: Aggregate cap on deductions under Section 80C (EPF, PPF, ELSS, life insurance premium, principal repayment on home loan, etc.). Not available under the new regime.
Cap on health insurance premium deduction for self, spouse and dependent children, where the eldest insured is below 60. Not available under the new regime.
Cap on health insurance premium deduction for self/family where the eldest insured is a senior citizen (60+). Not available under the new regime.
Old regime income tax slabs for individuals below 60 years.
rules.source: Income Tax Act, First Schedule (unchanged for FY 2025-26)

rules.description: Section 87A rebate under the old regime: full rebate (tax reduced to nil) if taxable income does not exceed the threshold, capped at the max rebate amount.
New regime income tax slabs, as revised by the Finance Act 2025 (effective AY 2026-27 / FY 2025-26).

Section 87A rebate under the new regime: full rebate (tax reduced to nil) if taxable income does not exceed the threshold, capped at the max rebate amount. Marginal relief applies just above the threshold (not modelled in this MVP).
rules.source: Income Tax Act, Section 87A, Finance Act 2025

rules.description: Health and Education Cess, applied on income tax after rebate, before surcharge.
rules.source: Income Tax Act, Section 87A read with Finance Act

rules.description: Variable/bonus pay above this share of CTC is flagged as a significant at-risk portion of total compensation.
Basic salary below this share of CTC is flagged, since PF, gratuity and HRA exemption all derive from Basic.
Notice periods longer than this many days are flagged as unusually long.
Weights applied to each offer-quality sub-score to produce the overall 0-100 Compensation Quality Score. Must sum to 1.0.
Fixed-compensation share of CTC at or above which the fixed-ratio sub-score is a full 100. Scales linearly to 0 at a 0% fixed ratio.
Annual in-hand pay as a share of CTC at or above which the take-home-ratio sub-score is a full 100. Scales linearly to 0 at a 0% take-home ratio.

Employer's NPS/superannuation contribution deductible from taxable income under Section 80CCD(2), as a percentage of (Basic + DA). Available under BOTH regimes, unlike 80C/80D. Private-sector rate; the 14% government-employee rate is not modelled.
Minimum years of continuous service required for gratuity to vest (become payable on exit). Death or permanent disablement is exempt from this requirement (not modelled here).

Minimum years of continuous service (aggregated across transferred EPF accounts via UAN) after which a full EPF withdrawal is tax-free. Withdrawing before this threshold makes the employer's contribution and interest taxable as salary/other income.
rules.source: Income Tax Act, Rule 8 of Part A, Fourth Schedule

rules.description: Minimum years of contributory service (aggregated via UAN transfer, not withdrawal) required to become eligible for the EPS monthly pension at retirement.
Point allocation (out of 100) for the benefits sub-score: employer PF present, gratuity provisioned, and ESI correctly handled (either contributed when eligible, or not applicable).
